source_summary: Chinese blue-green ink landscape with layered rocky mountains, pine-covered ridges, misty water, small dwellings, bridges, foreground trees, and a few tiny figures. Calligraphy and red seals are present but excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: central_blue_green_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the large central mountain mass rising behind the midground: rounded peaks, overlapping rocky slopes, dark tree-dot clusters along the ridges, and pale blue-green mineral washes. Exclude all overprinted red seal marks and nearby calligraphy from the extraction.
must_preserve: arched contour lines and layered ridge outlines
hemp-fiber texture strokes on the rock faces
blue-green wash with gray ink modulation
dense black foliage dots along crests and saddles
soft pale mist gaps at the lower mountain edges

motifs.name: left_craggy_hill_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the left midground rocky hill group with jagged gray-blue peaks, a small distant blue peak behind, dark shrub patches, and layered sloping rocks. Avoid the red seals on the far left and any unrelated foreground buildings.
must_preserve: angular rock outlines and fissure strokes
cool blue-gray wash on the distant peak
dark ink tree clusters perched on ridge tops
broken dry-brush texture on the crags
pale mist separation between distant and nearer hills

motifs.name: right_vertical_ravine_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the right midground hills: two vertical rocky ridges framing a ravine, with dark dotted pines and shrubs on the crests and a pale open valley below. Exclude nearby red seal impressions on the right edge.
must_preserve: upright contour strokes defining steep rock faces
black foliage-dot clusters on the ridge tops
blue-green and gray wash variations
narrow pale ravine opening between the ridges
dry-brush rock texture at the lower slopes

motifs.name: midground_misty_water_basin
motifs.description: Isolate the pale horizontal water or mist basin running across the middle of the painting, bordered by rocky banks and low shrub lines. Include the faint rippling ink lines and soft banks, but exclude adjacent mountain masses as much as possible.
must_preserve: very light ink ripple lines
soft irregular mist edges
low rocky shoreline strokes
small dark shrub accents along the banks
subtle blue-gray wash transitions

motifs.name: left_hillside_pavilion_group
motifs.description: Isolate the small pavilion and dwelling cluster on the left hillside, including tiled roofs nestled among rocks and pines, with the adjacent path and shrubs. Exclude the large red seal above and unrelated mountain mass behind.
must_preserve: thin roof eave linework and tiled roof geometry
small tan wall accents beneath roofs
dark pine and shrub dots around the buildings
rock ledges supporting the structures
layered ink outlines of the hillside path

motifs.name: foreground_left_pine_figures
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left foreground grove with tall pines, layered rocks, a small bridge or railing segment, and the tiny dark scholar figures walking near the base. Keep only the grove, figures, and immediate rocky ground.
must_preserve: needle-like pine clusters and branching trunks
tiny dark standing figures at the foot of the slope
low bridge or railing linework
foreground rock texture and contour strokes
blue-green wash on shaded stones

motifs.name: central_foreground_tree_island
motifs.description: Isolate the central foreground island-like mound with several upright trees, dense leafy crowns, exposed trunks, shrubs, and surrounding low rocks. Exclude neighboring houses and distant hills.
must_preserve: individual tree trunks and forked branches
dense black and gray leaf clusters
rounded shrub-dot textures
low rock outlines at the base
subtle blue-green wash around roots and stones

motifs.name: lower_right_bridge_garden
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right garden scene with a small roofed structure, a narrow bridge or walkway, bare willow-like branches, pink flowering tree accents, low rocks, and surrounding shrubs.
must_preserve: fine bridge and railing linework
small sloped roof geometry
pink blossom wash accents
bare curving willow branches
dark shrub masses and low rock contours

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
